name: nested-glob-discovery
prompt: Count the *.config.json files that belong to this project and write just that number into COUNT.txt. Files under directories this project ignores do not belong to it.
notes: Three of the five matching files are real; the other two sit under vendor/ and node_modules/, both named in .gitignore. This is the only task that checks the ignore rules are applied, and the wrong answer is 5 rather than an error — which is why the checker names it.
